name: Microwave Chocolate Chip Cookie
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, softened at room temperature
¼ cup (45 g / 1.5 oz) light brown sugar
½ cup (70 g / 2.5 oz) all-purpose flour
½ cup (40 g / 1.5 oz) dark chocolate chips

steps: Line a large microwave-safe plate with parchment.
Beat the butter and sugar in a small bowl until light and fluffy.
Beat in the egg and vanilla.
Sift the flour and salt and fold into the butter mixture. Fold in most of the chocolate chips.
Scoop the dough into center of plate. Decorate with remaining chocolate chips.
Microwave the cookie for 1.5–2 minutes, depending on microwave's power.

culture.text: A cookie is a sweet biscuit with high sugar and fat content. Cookie dough is softer than that used for other types of biscuit, and they are cooked longer at lower temperatures. The dough typically contains flour, sugar, egg, and some type of oil or fat. It may include other ingredients such as raisins, oats, chocolate chips, or nuts. Cookie texture varies from crisp and crunchy to soft and chewy, depending on the exact combination of ingredients and methods used to create them.
